_README: One line per company: the sleeve it primarily belongs to.
WHY THIS IS A FILE AND NOT A RULE. Full-text search finds the universe and
cannot classify it: 'bitcoin mining' appears in nearly every crypto company's
annual report - in the industry description, in the risk factors, in a sentence
about competitors - so a text signal for mining fires for almost everyone. A
precedence order over those signals classified BitGo, Bakkt and Galaxy Digital
as miners. BitGo is a custodian and Bakkt is payments.
The balance sheet is different: a company whose assets are mostly crypto is a
treasury vehicle whatever its text says, because that is what its shareholders
own. Those are assigned automatically and are not listed here.
SLEEVES: treasury, mining, exchange, infrastructure, stablecoin, tokenization
Anything absent here falls back to a text guess and is reported as PROVISIONAL
on every run, so an unfilled line is visible rather than silent.
